## Hartnett Capital

Source: https://hartnettcapital.com/

Summary: Hartnett Capital is a private investment and operating company in McLean, Virginia, acquiring and building durable businesses and differentiated assets.

Private investment & operating company Building enduring value through ownership and operation. Founded and headquartered in McLean, Virginia, Hartnett Capital acquires, builds, and operates companies, real estate, digital assets, software, intellectual property, and proprietary data. Share an opportunity ↗ About Hartnett Capital ↗ Hartnett / Investment + Operations Acquire. Operate. Build. Hold. 01 / Our mission Build value that compounds across generations. We acquire and build enduring companies and assets, strengthen them through disciplined operations, and create lasting value through technology, data, relationships, and long-term ownership. We invest with the intention of being responsible, engaged owners—preserving what already works, improving what does not, and building toward the asset’s long-term potential. Hartnett Capital is a privately held investment and operating company founded and headquartered in McLean, Virginia. What does Hartnett Capital invest in? Hartnett Capital considers operating companies, commercial and residential real estate, software and platforms, digital assets, proprietary data, intellectual property, brands, media properties, and infrastructure. How does Hartnett Capital create value? Hartnett Capital acquires and builds durable assets, then strengthens them through disciplined operations, technology, automation, data, capital, relationships, and long-term ownership. Who does Hartnett Capital partner with? Hartnett Capital works with business owners, founders, independent operators, property owners, developers, investors, family offices, advisors, intermediaries, and strategic partners. How can I share an opportunity with Hartnett Capital? Send a concise overview and relevant context to inquiries@hartnettcapital.com. Inquiries are reviewed directly and discreetly. Start a conversation ↗

## About

Source: https://hartnettcapital.com/firm/

Summary: Learn about Hartnett Capital, a privately held investment and operating company in McLean, Virginia, built for active ownership and long-term value.

01 About Hartnett Capital Built to own. Equipped to operate. Founded and headquartered in McLean, Virginia, we are a privately held investment and operating company focused on acquiring, building, and managing durable businesses and differentiated assets. Our perspective Long-term ownership creates room for meaningful improvement. Our interests include operating companies, commercial and residential real estate, websites, domains, software products, proprietary datasets, intellectual property, brands, media properties, and infrastructure. We seek situations where patient capital, active management, technology, automation, and strong relationships can create durable value. We can acquire established assets, improve underperforming operations, partner with capable operators, or build new ventures internally. Our values Standards for ownership. 01 Ownership We take responsibility for outcomes and treat every asset as if we intend to own it indefinitely. 02 Integrity We communicate directly, honor our commitments, and protect the trust placed in us. 03 Discipline We make decisions based on fundamentals, evidence, and long-term value. 04 Resourcefulness We find practical ways to improve operations, solve problems, and create value. 05 Stewardship We aim to leave businesses, properties, and relationships stronger than we found them. 06 Independence We maintain the flexibility to pursue opportunities others may overlook or misunderstand. What we bring A flexible mandate. A hands-on model. 01 Independent judgment We evaluate each opportunity on its fundamentals and make decisions with a long-term owner’s perspective. 02 Direct engagement Partners work directly with decision-makers who remain involved from the first conversation through ownership. 03 Operating capability We contribute practical work across strategy, systems, technology, automation, data, and commercial execution. 04 Patient perspective We give strong assets and capable people the time, attention, and reinvestment required to compound. Our philosophy “Understand what makes an asset valuable. Preserve it. Then improve everything around it.” Our decisions are guided by fundamentals rather than trends. We favor durable demand, clear ownership advantages, strong cash-generation potential, and opportunities where focused execution can produce meaningful improvement. See what we do ↗

## What We Do

Source: https://hartnettcapital.com/strategy/

Summary: Hartnett Capital acquires, operates, builds, improves, partners, and holds durable businesses and differentiated assets.

02 What we do Acquire. Operate. Build. Hold. We combine capital, operating capability, technology, and long-term relationships to strengthen the assets under our control. 01 Acquire Established assets with a durable foundation. We acquire businesses and assets with recurring demand, defensible value, or meaningful growth potential. Where we focus Operating companies Real estate and specialty properties Digital, data, and intellectual-property assets 02 Operate Attention where it changes the outcome. We take an active role in strategy, systems, technology, financial performance, and day-to-day execution. Where we focus Strategy and capital allocation Operating systems and accountability Technology, automation, and data 03 Build Create when the best asset does not yet exist. We launch new companies, products, platforms, datasets, brands, and digital properties when an opportunity is better created than purchased. Where we focus Internal ventures Software and digital products Brands, media, and proprietary data 04 Improve Make strong foundations more valuable. We modernize operations through better processes, technology, automation, data, branding, and management. Where we focus Operational discipline Technology-enabled efficiency Commercial and brand development 05 Partner Aligned people expand what is possible. We form long-term relationships with founders, operators, investors, property owners, developers, and strategic partners. Where we focus Operator-led acquisitions Joint ventures Strategic and capital partnerships 06 Hold Let exceptional assets compound. We prioritize durable ownership and compounding value over short-term financial engineering. Where we focus Patient capital Responsible stewardship Flexible time horizons How we create value Fundamentals first. Execution every day. 01 Understand Identify the real source of value, the people who sustain it, and the risks that matter. 02 Align Match the ownership structure, incentives, and responsibilities to the opportunity. 03 Improve Apply focused operating work, technology, data, and capital where they can change the outcome. 04 Compound Reinvest in durable advantages and allow long-term ownership to do its work. Review our criteria ↗

## Operating Companies

Source: https://hartnettcapital.com/focus/operating-companies/

Summary: Hartnett Capital considers established operating companies with durable demand, sound economics, trusted relationships, and meaningful room to improve.

03 Operating Companies Businesses worth improving, not dismantling. We look for established companies with a useful role in their markets, a durable reason to exist, and a clear opportunity for engaged ownership to make them stronger. Our perspective A durable foundation comes first. A good business is more than a financial profile. It is a system of customers, employees, capabilities, reputation, and operating knowledge. We seek to understand and preserve those strengths before changing what surrounds them. Every situation is evaluated on its own merits. Fit depends on the quality of the underlying asset, the people around it, and our ability to contribute meaningfully over time. What we look for Signals of long-term fit. 01 Durable demand Products or services customers continue to need across cycles. 02 Sound economics Healthy cash generation or a credible path to sustainable profitability. 03 Trusted position Customer, supplier, employee, or community relationships worth protecting. 04 Operating headroom Practical opportunities to improve systems, execution, technology, or growth. Where we can contribute Ownership with practical operating depth. 01 Operating rhythm Clear priorities, useful metrics, accountable execution, and better decision cadence. 02 Technology Practical software, automation, and data that make the company easier to run and serve. 03 Commercial focus Sharper positioning, customer development, pricing discipline, and repeatable growth. 04 Reinvestment Patient capital directed toward capabilities and advantages that can compound. The opportunity “The right company has something real to preserve and a practical path to becoming more valuable.” If that describes an asset you own, advise, or know well, we welcome a direct and confidential introduction. Share an opportunity ↗ Review our criteria ↗

## Real Estate

Source: https://hartnettcapital.com/focus/real-estate/

Summary: Hartnett Capital considers commercial, residential, specialty, land, and infrastructure opportunities where active ownership can strengthen long-term value.

03 Real Estate Useful places with unrealized potential. We consider real estate and related assets where location, utility, scarcity, or a durable use case provides a strong foundation for long-term ownership. Our perspective A durable foundation comes first. Our interest is not limited to a single property type. We focus on what makes a place useful, how it serves the people around it, and where better management, investment, or redevelopment can improve the outcome. Every situation is evaluated on its own merits. Fit depends on the quality of the underlying asset, the people around it, and our ability to contribute meaningfully over time. What we look for Signals of long-term fit. 01 Durable utility A clear use case supported by practical demand rather than a temporary narrative. 02 Location advantage Access, scarcity, community context, or infrastructure that is difficult to reproduce. 03 Ownership flexibility A structure that supports patient decision-making and responsible stewardship. 04 Improvement potential Room for better management, repositioning, redevelopment, or operational efficiency. Where we can contribute Ownership with practical operating depth. 01 Asset strategy A grounded plan for use, positioning, capital needs, and long-term value. 02 Active management Attention to operations, tenant or resident experience, maintenance, and accountability. 03 Thoughtful capital Disciplined improvements tied to utility, resilience, and durable demand. 04 Partnership structure Flexible alignment with owners, developers, operators, and capital partners. The opportunity “We favor real assets whose value can be strengthened through useful improvements and responsible ownership.” If that describes an asset you own, advise, or know well, we welcome a direct and confidential introduction. ## Software & Platforms

Source: https://hartnettcapital.com/focus/software-platforms/

Summary: Hartnett Capital considers software products and platforms with practical utility, valuable workflows, and opportunities for focused product and operating improvement.

03 Software & Platforms Useful products that can become essential. We look for software and platforms that solve specific problems, support valuable workflows, and can become more capable through focused product development and disciplined operations. Our perspective A durable foundation comes first. The strongest software businesses earn their place in a customer’s day-to-day work. We value genuine utility, close customer understanding, sensible economics, and product decisions grounded in durable needs. Every situation is evaluated on its own merits. Fit depends on the quality of the underlying asset, the people around it, and our ability to contribute meaningfully over time. What we look for Signals of long-term fit. 01 Clear utility A product that solves an identifiable problem and creates repeatable user value. 02 Embedded workflow A meaningful role in how customers operate, decide, transact, or communicate. 03 Sensible economics Revenue quality and delivery costs that can support durable reinvestment. 04 Product headroom Opportunities to improve usability, reliability, capabilities, or distribution. Where we can contribute Ownership with practical operating depth. 01 Product discipline Prioritization built around customer value, adoption, retention, and quality. 02 Technical leverage Automation, integrations, data, and modern infrastructure applied pragmatically. 03 Go-to-market systems Clear positioning and repeatable acquisition, onboarding, and customer success. 04 Long-term roadmap Patient development of features and advantages that deepen the product’s usefulness. The opportunity “We are interested in software that matters to its users and has room to become materially better.” If that describes an asset you own, advise, or know well, we welcome a direct and confidential introduction. ## Digital Assets

Source: https://hartnettcapital.com/focus/digital-assets/

Summary: Hartnett Capital considers websites, domains, media properties, and other digital assets with durable demand, owned distribution, and room for commercial improvement.

03 Digital Assets Owned distribution in durable markets. We consider websites, domains, media properties, and related digital assets that have earned attention, authority, direct demand, or a distinctive position online. Our perspective A durable foundation comes first. A digital asset can be valuable because it helps people find, understand, or accomplish something important. We look beyond traffic alone to the quality of the audience, the durability of demand, and the usefulness of the experience. Every situation is evaluated on its own merits. Fit depends on the quality of the underlying asset, the people around it, and our ability to contribute meaningfully over time. What we look for Signals of long-term fit. 01 Direct demand Organic, referral, repeat, or branded usage that is not dependent on one paid channel. 02 Distinct position Authority, naming, content, community, or distribution that is hard to recreate. 03 Audience quality Users with a clear purpose and a reason to return, subscribe, or transact. 04 Commercial headroom Ways to improve the product, experience, revenue model, or market reach. Where we can contribute Ownership with practical operating depth. 01 Experience Faster, clearer, and more useful products built around audience intent. 02 Content systems Structured production, quality standards, and responsible use of automation. 03 Monetization Revenue models aligned with user trust and the asset’s long-term position. 04 Distribution resilience Broader direct relationships and less dependence on any single platform. The opportunity “The most compelling digital assets pair durable attention with genuine utility and owned relationships.” If that describes an asset you own, advise, or know well, we welcome a direct and confidential introduction. Fit depends on the quality of the underlying asset, the people around it, and our ability to contribute meaningfully over time. Where we can contribute Ownership with practical operating depth. 01 Data operations Stronger collection, normalization, quality control, governance, and maintenance. 02 Productization Useful interfaces, workflows, alerts, and APIs built around customer decisions. 03 Enrichment Technology and domain expertise that make the underlying information more valuable. 04 Responsible access Clear rights, thoughtful controls, and durable trust with sources and users. ## Intellectual Property & Brands

Source: https://hartnettcapital.com/focus/intellectual-property-brands/

Summary: Hartnett Capital considers brands, patents, trademarks, licenses, and other intellectual property with defensible ownership, recognition, utility, or extension potential.

03 Intellectual Property & Brands Distinctive rights with room to travel. We consider brands and intellectual property that hold recognition, trust, scarcity, technical utility, or a meaningful right to participate in a market. Our perspective A durable foundation comes first. Strong intellectual property creates value only when it is protected, relevant, and thoughtfully applied. We look for assets with clear ownership and a credible path to broader use without weakening what makes them distinctive. Every situation is evaluated on its own merits. Fit depends on the quality of the underlying asset, the people around it, and our ability to contribute meaningfully over time. What we look for Signals of long-term fit. 01 Defensible ownership Clear rights, documentation, protections, and freedom to use or extend the asset. 02 Existing relevance Recognition, trust, technical value, or a proven role in the market. 03 Authentic fit A coherent reason for the property to exist and for customers or partners to care. 04 Extension potential Thoughtful opportunities across products, markets, channels, or licensing. Where we can contribute Ownership with practical operating depth. 01 Positioning A sharper articulation of the asset’s meaning, value, and intended audience. 02 Protection Disciplined attention to rights, usage, consistency, and long-term defensibility. 03 Commercialization Products, licensing, distribution, and partnerships that respect the core asset. 04 Stewardship Patient decisions that strengthen relevance without trading away trust. The opportunity “We seek intellectual property with something genuine to protect and a responsible way to extend it.” If that describes an asset you own, advise, or know well, we welcome a direct and confidential introduction. ## Investment Criteria

Source: https://hartnettcapital.com/criteria/

Summary: Explore the business and asset characteristics Hartnett Capital considers when evaluating acquisitions and partnerships.

04 Investment criteria Durable foundations. Meaningful potential. We are most interested in businesses and assets where long-term ownership, focused execution, and strong relationships can create measurable value. What earns a closer look The qualities we value. 01 Durable demand A product, service, property, or asset supported by recurring or resilient demand. 02 Sound economics Positive cash flow or a credible, understandable path to profitability. 03 Defensible value Intellectual property, data, brand equity, digital presence, scarcity, or another ownership advantage. 04 Trusted relationships Strong customer, community, supplier, or market relationships worth preserving. 05 Room to improve Clear opportunities for operational, technological, commercial, or management improvement. 06 Thoughtful transition Owners who care about continuity, reputation, employees, customers, and the next chapter. 07 Capable operators Experienced people seeking aligned capital and a long-term operating partner. 08 Overlooked potential Assets that have been underdeveloped, undercapitalized, or poorly managed. 09 Long-term fit The potential to create meaningful value through patient, responsible ownership. Areas of interest A broad mandate. A consistent philosophy. Companies Operating & recurring revenue Real assets Real estate, land & infrastructure Technology Software, platforms & applications Digital Websites, domains, data & media Intellectual property Brands, patents, trademarks & licenses Structures Acquisitions, ventures & partnerships Fit is determined by the quality of the opportunity and our ability to contribute—not by a checklist alone. ## Owners & Founders

Source: https://hartnettcapital.com/partnerships/owners-founders/

Summary: Hartnett Capital works directly with owners and founders considering succession, a sale, recapitalization, or the next stage of a company's growth.

05 Owners & Founders A thoughtful next chapter for what you built. We work with owners and founders who care about more than a transaction—including continuity, reputation, employees, customers, and the long-term future of the business. How we begin Understand the people and the opportunity. Every transition carries its own history, priorities, and responsibilities. We begin by understanding what matters to the owner, what makes the company valuable, and what the next chapter should protect or make possible. We evaluate every relationship individually. The aim is a practical partnership in which incentives, authority, and expectations are understood before the work begins. What matters A strong basis for alignment. 01 Direct dialogue Conversations with the people responsible for evaluating and operating the opportunity. 02 Discretion A careful process that respects sensitive information, relationships, and timing. 03 Flexible structure A willingness to consider the form of transition that best fits the situation. 04 Continuity Attention to the customers, employees, reputation, and capabilities behind the company. A deliberate process Clarity before commitment. 01 Understand the priorities Learn why the owner is considering a transition and what a good outcome means. 02 Study the business Assess the company’s durable strengths, economics, risks, and opportunities to improve. 03 Shape the path Align on structure, responsibilities, timing, and the role each party will play. 04 Build the next chapter Preserve what works and invest deliberately in the company’s long-term potential. Our standard “A transition should honor what created the company’s value and give it room to compound.” If you see a potential fit, send a concise introduction. We review opportunities directly and discreetly. Start a conversation ↗ Explore all partnerships ↗

A deliberate process Clarity before commitment. 01 Define the thesis Clarify the target, the operating plan, and the specific source of advantage. 02 Test the fit Evaluate the opportunity, working relationship, responsibilities, and downside together. 03 Align the structure Set clear authority, incentives, capital commitments, and decision rights. 04 Operate with cadence Work from shared priorities, useful measures, direct communication, and patient goals. ## Strategic Partners

05 Strategic Partners Complementary strengths expand what is possible. We work with partners who bring specialized knowledge, proprietary access, operating capability, relationships, or long-term capital to opportunities where alignment matters. How we begin Understand the people and the opportunity. A useful partnership begins with a clear reason to work together. We look for complementary contributions, direct communication, well-defined responsibilities, and a shared standard for how the opportunity should be evaluated and managed. We evaluate every relationship individually. The aim is a practical partnership in which incentives, authority, and expectations are understood before the work begins. What matters A strong basis for alignment. 01 Distinct contribution Expertise, access, relationships, operating capability, or capital that changes the outcome. 02 Shared standards A common approach to diligence, communication, stewardship, and long-term value. 03 Clear responsibilities Defined ownership of decisions, workstreams, reporting, and ongoing operations. 04 Durable alignment Economics and expectations designed for the real time horizon of the opportunity. A deliberate process Clarity before commitment. 01 Introduce the opportunity Share the asset, context, parties involved, and why the partnership may fit. 02 Compare perspectives Test the thesis, risks, capabilities, and each party’s intended contribution. 03 Define alignment Agree on structure, governance, responsibilities, timing, and measures of progress. 04 Execute together Maintain direct communication and a practical cadence from decision through ownership. Our standard “The strongest partnerships are specific about why each party belongs and what each is responsible for.” If you see a potential fit, send a concise introduction. We review opportunities directly and discreetly. Start a conversation ↗ Explore all partnerships ↗

## Frequently Asked Questions

Source: https://hartnettcapital.com/faq/

Summary: Answers to common questions about Hartnett Capital's investment focus, ownership approach, partnerships, evaluation process, and opportunity submissions.

07 Frequently asked questions Clear answers. Direct access. A practical overview of our mandate, ownership approach, partnership model, and how to begin a conversation. 01 Hartnett Capital What is Hartnett Capital? Hartnett Capital is a privately held investment and operating company founded and headquartered in McLean, Virginia. We acquire, build, operate, improve, partner with, and hold durable businesses and differentiated assets. Is Hartnett Capital a private equity fund? Hartnett Capital describes itself as a private investment and operating company. Its flexible mandate and long-term ownership approach are built around the needs of each opportunity rather than a single transaction template. What is Hartnett Capital's investment horizon? We prioritize patient ownership and the long-term compounding of value. The right horizon depends on the asset, but our decisions are not driven by a predetermined short-term exit schedule. 02 Investment focus What does Hartnett Capital invest in? We consider operating companies, commercial and residential real estate, software and platforms, websites and domains, media properties, proprietary data, intellectual property, brands, and related differentiated assets. Does an opportunity need to fit a specific industry? No. Our mandate is intentionally broad. We focus on durable demand, understandable value, defensible advantages, responsible ownership, and a credible path to meaningful improvement. Does Hartnett Capital only acquire established assets? No. We can acquire established assets, improve underperforming operations, partner with capable operators, or build new companies, products, platforms, datasets, brands, and digital properties internally. What characteristics make an opportunity attractive? We value durable demand, sound economics, defensible value, trusted relationships, capable people, room to improve, and the potential to compound through focused long-term ownership. 03 Partnerships & process Who does Hartnett Capital partner with? We work with business owners, founders, independent operators, property owners, developers, investors, family offices, advisors, intermediaries, and strategic partners. What role does Hartnett Capital play after an investment? Our model is active. Depending on the opportunity, we can contribute across strategy, operating systems, technology, automation, data, financial performance, commercial execution, capital allocation, and long-term planning. Can Hartnett Capital support an owner transition? Yes. We welcome conversations with owners considering succession, a sale, recapitalization, or the next stage of growth, especially when continuity, reputation, employees, and customers matter to the outcome. Does Hartnett Capital partner with independent operators? Yes. We are interested in working with experienced operators who have relevant expertise, a clear investment or operating thesis, and a long-term standard for value creation. How are opportunities evaluated? We begin by understanding the asset, the people around it, its durable strengths, its economics, the risks that matter, and the practical work required to improve it. Each opportunity is evaluated on its own merits. How can I share an opportunity? Email a concise overview, relevant context, and the best next contact to inquiries@hartnettcapital.com. Inquiries are reviewed directly and discreetly. Still have a question? Start with the opportunity. Our mandate is broad by design, and the quality of an opportunity cannot always be reduced to a checklist. Share a concise overview and relevant context. If there may be a fit, we will follow up directly. Contact Hartnett Capital ↗

What happens next We review inquiries directly and discreetly. If the opportunity aligns with our interests, we will follow up to request more context or arrange a conversation. A useful first note 01 The opportunity A plain-language description of the business, asset, property, or partnership. 02 The context Ownership, location, stage, and the reason you are beginning a conversation now. 03 The potential What is durable today and where focused ownership could make it more valuable. 04 The next step The person we should speak with and the best way to continue the discussion.
